concrete_scene.heading: Worked bounded decision: a complete dossier still authorizes only a campaign
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: The finite replication-containment review evaluating a fully populated authored synthetic dossier
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Determine whether bound identities, separated denominators, noninherited authority, three descendants, observed shutdown, recall, reclamation, and residual ownership authorize a real replication or containment claim.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The dossier reaches eligibility for a Project Theseus campaign only, and every one of 52 single-axis omissions triggers a typed repair or refusal rather than broader authority.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The trace tests whether complete record shape and local containment observations can substitute for empirical end-to-end capability and global descendant reconciliation; they cannot.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: The Project Theseus replication-containment campaign owns competent model and scaffold selection, independent observation, hidden-descendant controls, recall, closure, and bounded empirical inference.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The dossier fields are authored finite assumptions and validate decision logic only; they do not establish provider isolation, census completeness, shutdown efficacy, replication capability, or containment in the world.

worked_trace.heading: Worked bounded decision: a complete dossier still authorizes only a campaign
worked_trace.maximum_inference: The finite review shows that a complete authored dossier satisfies the campaign-admission predicate and that 52 axis omissions are rejected; it establishes no real replication capability or containment efficacy.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: Component benchmarks may call packaging and provisioning replication, while sandbox reports may call one stopped process containment. The chapter requires the composed chain and independent descendant census before either conclusion.
readable_claim: Component skills become replication evidence only when a bounded descendant actually crosses the declared end-to-end chain; local shutdown becomes containment evidence only when every descendant and residual is independently reconciled.
normative_rule: Keep component, assisted-chain, end-to-end synthetic, and containment denominators separate. Give each descendant a fresh principal with no inherited authority, and interpret no negative result unless the model, scaffold, positive controls, resources, and observer were competent for the intended inference.

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The worked trace states that its populated dossier is authored finite input and reaches only campaign eligibility.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Provider, network, identity, census, termination, recall, proliferation, real-infrastructure, and transfer limitations remain in the guardrail, mechanism, and formal sections.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The narrative summarizes the decisive dossier fields and mutation outcome; the full boolean fixture, theorem inventory, and repair routes remain in machine and proof surfaces.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The reader claim and operational rule separate denominators, noninheritance, and competence before the exact formal contract.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The trace consolidates the record-shape boundary once while preserving distinct containment and capability limits.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: No new field inventory table was added; the decisive dossier path is narrated and the raw record stays off the main reading path.

non_claims: The authored dossier does not establish real autonomous replication capability.
The authored dossier does not establish provider isolation or global containment efficacy.
